content.learning_goal: Teach the central ideas of Measurement of Length and Motion accurately and accessibly.

explanation_sections.title: Connect
explanation_sections.explanation: Activate prior knowledge and invite a prediction.

explanation_sections.title: Explain
explanation_sections.explanation: Build understanding from the source-grounded evidence.
source_evidence: The shopkeeper measures the cloth using a metal measuring rod.
Then, the tailor takes her measurements using a flexible measuring tape.
Her mother instructs the tailor to increase the length of her uniform by char angula (four fingers width).
Are the tape and rod similar to the scale that the elder sister has in her geometry box?

explanation_sections.title: Apply
explanation_sections.explanation: Move from a chapter example to a new related situation.

explanation_sections.title: Close
explanation_sections.explanation: Retrieve the central idea and supporting reasoning.

misconceptions: Confusing an example with the general idea.
checks_for_understanding: Can you explain it in your own words?
content.closure: State the central idea and one application.
